posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Greetings, Sentinels fans!

I’ve made you a set of documents! When we launch our new site in a couple weeks here, these will be available to anyone and everyone as downloads, but we wanted to preview them here first. Most of this stuff the playtesters have already seen, but we love all our forum-goers and wanted to get this out to all of you so you’ll have an idea of what’s coming.

Here are the changes for the Sentinels of the Multiverse: Enhanced Edition heroes!

And here are the changes for the Sentinels of the Multiverse: Enhanced Edition villains!
And also there are changes to the Sentinels of the Multiverse: Enhanced Edition environments!
These documents have 1-to-1 ratio copies of the text portions of the changed cards, so you can print them out and put them in sleeves with your original edition cards to update them. If you do so, make sure you set the printer to print at 100% of the size of the document.

Anyway, enjoy! And feel free to give feedback in case I (GASP!) did something wrong!

-Christopher

I had time to look at the villains and environments. More errors spotted.

Baron Blade Text Front Gameplay. 2nd paragraph. 2 instances of Baron Blade in italics.

Baron Blade. Text Front says Mobile Defense Platform without quotes. Text Back uses quotes. Consistency needed.

Citizen Dawn Text Back. Gameplay. First two words. Citizen Dawn in italics.

Citizen Dawn Text Back. Advanced. Citizen Dawn in italics.

Primordial Plant Life. River of Lava. Volcanic Eruption. Police Backup. Toxic Seaweed. Oxygen Leak. Need to add the words “This card” in front of “Deal”.

Rooftop Combat. “in a single round” is inconsistent with “in one round” used in Disintegration Ray and Electro-magnetic Railgun. Consistency needed.

Phosphorescent Chamber. Word “all” missing. i.e. Increase all damage dealth by 1. Increase all HP recovery by 1.

Phosphorescent Chamber. Use of both “discard a card” and “discard 1 card” in the same card text. Consistency needed.

Fire in the Biosphere. I find the effects of Fire in the Biosphere and Primordial Plant Life identical. i.e. Each Hero may destroy 1 Ongoing. If they do, take 2 damage; if they don’t, take 4 damage. It will be better to choose 1 or the other and maintain the same phrasing.

Maintenance level. So far, titles of cards were not in quotes with quoted. So “Self-Destruct Sequence” should not be in quotes here.

Self-Destruct Sequence. “When this card comes into play” should be “When this card enters play”. “Discard top card” should be “Discard the top card”.

I'm not entirely sure what you're looking for.  All I'm doing is using Photoshop to open the PDF that Christopher published and copying/pasting each card part until there's enough on a page.  Then I turn the page back into a PDF and post it.  So the native format is a Photoshop document, but it's really just full of individual pastes of what you see in Christopher's PDF, nothing editable.  Would that be helpful to you?  I don't have original files of cards with text and images and everything on separate layers.

What does "print the villain cards minus the changes to the villain rules cards" mean?  Isn't a villain card minus the changes just the way the villain card is originally?  Why would you want to print that since presumably, you already have a card in your hand that's like that?

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: When he says that he doesn't want changes to the villain rules cards, he is refering to the text portion of the villain character card.  Likely he already has the pack of oversized villain cards which have already been fixed, and thus he doesn't need the change set for those cards.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: OK.  In any case, since I don't have original files with the text and images on separate layers, it sounds like I don't have what he needs.

posts.name: kronmichael
posts.cooked: I am basically asking for the document before you printed it to pdf. The reason was I wanted to delete some of the cards before printing the sheet. Specifically, I wanted to remove from the villain sheet the changes to the villain rules cards (the ones that go into play at the very beginning of setup), because I use larger villain cards and didn’t want to waste the ink.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: Sure, how about if I just prepare you a special version without the changed villain rules?  I don't think that will be a popular request for most people, but it would be easy enough to do a one-off for you. I've got a couple of things on my plate to finish, but I think I could do that before the weekend. When it's ready, I'll let you know.

posts.name: kronmichael
posts.cooked: That'd be very cool, Spiff, thank you.  But if it's easier I don't mind working from the document.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Sorry it's taken me so long to finish this, but those environment cards took a lot of typing.  As of now, the file that's available on my site (www.spiffworld.com/sotm) has all the inserts for all the cards.  In addition, I've got a "kronmichael special" file available here (www.spiffworld.com/sotm/files/kronmichael_special.zip) that is just the villain inserts minus the villain card parts.  By removing the villain cards, I was able to move the inserts from the third page onto the first and second page, so not only is kronmichael going to save printer ink this way, but paper too.  Good times.

I don't expect the kronmichael special to be a particularly popular option for most people however, so if you can tell me when you've downloaded that file, kronmichael, I'm going to remove it from my server afterwards.  Thanks.

As a final note, re-typing in all of that text from the environment cards really punctuates something I've been saying from the beginning -- there is far too much space being taken up on cards by the words "at the start of the xxx turn" and "at the end of the xxx turn". I understand the original reasoning behind spelling it out verbosely, but I strenuously posit that the readability of the cards would be vastly improved (and the amount of space available for text that actually does need to be read each time) by turning those two phrases into a simple icon.  I hope that just how Rook City brought us the "H' mechanic, the next expansion could bring us the big "start/end icon" revolution.

posts.name: ketigid
posts.cooked: Nightmist has icons too! And I support Spiff's start/end icon (r)evolution.

posts.name: kronmichael
posts.cooked: Thanks, Spiff. I am not sure why anyone who uses your excellent oversized villain cards would also want to print inserts for cards they don’t use. But might I suggest that if you put those revisions together on a third page appended to the end of my special file, future users could simply decide whether or not they wish to print that page, adding some versatility for those who use your large cards while still covering those who want it all?

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: That's a great suggestion.  I'll do that.
